name: Camping Schlossberg Itter
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Schlossberg Itter is situated in the village of Itter in the Brixental valley, right at the foot of the historic Schlossberg hill. It features well-equipped pitches for motorhomes and caravans alongside rental mobile homes. Facilities include an outdoor swimming pool and a children's playground. From Itter, the vast ski domains of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental and Hopfgarten are easily accessible.
